anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading activity is minimal with zero active trades and total profit/loss, which may indicate issues with strategy execution or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially update AI algorithms or data inputs to ensure they are functioning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate and adjust trading strategies to improve engagement and profitability.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and mitigate the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Assess the AI module's configuration and data inputs to ensure it is operational and generating insights.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Analyze current trading strategies and market conditions to identify reasons for inactivity and adjust strategies accordingly.
recommendations.rationale: Improving trading strategy performance can enhance profitability and user engagement.
